Script 6 - Beta diversity metrics & analyses

Microplastic exposure alters immune-related gene expression in Culex quinquefasciatus mosquitoes and larval microbiota diversity

Ahamed TCHATAKOURA, Marie BUYSSE, Marie-Laure SETIER RIO, Olivier ROUX, Claire LOISEAU, Amandine AVILES

0. Loading libraries

library(phyloseq)
library(microbiome)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel) 
library(ggpubr)
library(dplyr)
library(kableExtra)
library(vegan) 
library(tidyr)
library(metagMisc)
library(pairwiseAdonis)

0. Load the datasets

load("rdata_ALL_genus_rel.RData")
load("rdata_LARVES_genus_rel.RData")
load("rdata_FEMALE_genus_rel.RData")

metadata <- read.table("metadata.txt", sep="\t", dec = ",", header = TRUE, fill = TRUE, row.names = 1)
metadata$stage <- as.factor(metadata$stage)
metadata$stage <- factor(metadata$stage, levels = c("larvae", "female", "standard"))
metadata$sample_type <- as.factor(metadata$sample_type)
metadata$sample_type <- factor(metadata$sample_type, levels = c("larvae_whole", "female_whole", "female_midgut"))
metadata$treatment <- as.factor(metadata$treatment)
metadata$treatment <- factor(metadata$treatment, levels = c("control", "60", "200", "600"))
metadata$exposition <- as.factor(metadata$exposition)
metadata$exposition <- factor(metadata$exposition, levels = c("unexposed", "exposed"))
metadata$run <- as.factor(metadata$run)
metadata$stage_exp <- as.factor(metadata$stage_exp)
metadata$stage_exp <- factor(metadata$stage_exp, levels = c("UNEXP_larvae", "EXP_larvae", "UNEXP_female", "EXP_female", "UNEXP_femaleMID", "EXP_femaleMID"))

metadata_all <- metadata %>%
  filter(stage %in% c("larvae", "female"))

metadata_L <- metadata %>%
  filter(stage %in% c("larvae"))

metadata_F <- metadata %>%
  filter(stage %in% c("female"))

Let’s produce the beta-diversity matrices:

bray <- phyloseq::distance(rdata_genus_rel, method = "bray")
jaccard <- phyloseq::distance(rdata_genus_rel, method = "jaccard")
wunifrac <- phyloseq::distance(rdata_genus_rel, method = "wunifrac")

bray_L <- phyloseq::distance(rdata_L_genus_rel, method = "bray")
jaccard_L <- phyloseq::distance(rdata_L_genus_rel, method = "jaccard")
wunifrac_L <- phyloseq::distance(rdata_L_genus_rel, method = "wunifrac")

bray_F <- phyloseq::distance(rdata_F_genus_rel, method = "bray")
jaccard_F <- phyloseq::distance(rdata_F_genus_rel, method = "jaccard")
wunifrac_F <- phyloseq::distance(rdata_F_genus_rel, method = "wunifrac")

We create a dataset with only control individuals:

metadata_ctl <- metadata_all %>%
  filter(exposition %in% c("unexposed"))

load("Rdatasets/Manip_Ahamed_rdata_ALL.RData")
rdata_ctl_1 <- subset_samples(rdata_all, exposition %in% c("unexposed"))
rdata_ctl <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(rdata_ctl_1) > 0, rdata_ctl_1)
rdata_ctl_genus <- tax_glom(rdata_ctl, taxrank=rank_names(rdata_ctl)[6])
rdata_ctl_genus <- phyloseq_rm_na_tax(rdata_ctl_genus)
rdata_ctl_genus_rel <- microbiome::transform(rdata_ctl_genus, "compositional")

bray_ctl <- phyloseq::distance(rdata_ctl_genus_rel, method = "bray")
jaccard_ctl <- phyloseq::distance(rdata_ctl_genus_rel, method = "jaccard")
wunifrac_ctl <- phyloseq::distance(rdata_ctl_genus_rel, method = "wunifrac")

1. Separation between larvae, whole females, and female midguts

We hypothesize that bacterial communities differ depending on the stage of the mosquito’s development, but also depending on the sampling scale (whole organism vs. dissected organ). Consequently, prior to investigating the impact of MP exposure, significant differences in beta diversity among sample types were tested. To avoid a confounding effect with MP exposure, only unexposed individuals were considered. 

PERMANOVA:
PERMANOVA according to sample type in unexposed samples

PERMANOVA_Jaccard 0.0033 4.957556 0.4524327
PERMANOVA_WUnifrac 0.0022 9.151698 0.6040048

BETADISPER according to sample type in unexposed samples

Betadisper_Bray 0.7141235 0.723
Betadisper_Jaccard 0.7938717 0.770
Betadisper_WUnifrac 0.8974586 0.918

Let’s also perform pairwise comparisons:

pairwise.adonis2(bray_ctl ~ sample_type, data = metadata_ctl, permutations = 9999, p.adjust.m = "BH")

3. Whole females dataset

We create a dataset with only whole females:

metadata_FW <- metadata_F %>%
  filter(sample_type %in% c("female_whole"))

load("rdata_FEMALE.RData")
rdata_FW_1 <- subset_samples(rdata_F, sample_type %in% c("female_whole"))
rdata_FW <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(rdata_FW_1) > 0, rdata_FW_1)
rdata_FW_genus <- tax_glom(rdata_FW, taxrank=rank_names(rdata_FW)[6])
rdata_FW_genus <- phyloseq_rm_na_tax(rdata_FW_genus)
rdata_FW_genus_rel <- microbiome::transform(rdata_FW_genus, "compositional")

bray_FW <- phyloseq::distance(rdata_FW_genus_rel, method = "bray")
jaccard_FW <- phyloseq::distance(rdata_FW_genus_rel, method = "jaccard")
wunifrac_FW <- phyloseq::distance(rdata_FW_genus_rel, method = "wunifrac")
